title: Persist inquiry audit events and owner-notification outbox
requirements: Add change_events, event_inquiries, event_visits, notification_recipient_state, notification_jobs and notification_attempts.
Use UUID keys, receipt linkage, restrictive foreign keys, version/status/lease/check constraints and indexes required for deterministic audit and retry handling.
Add isolated PostgreSQL migration tests under tests/db005 without altering application code or existing integration-test scope.
Do not send notifications, create endpoints, store provider secrets, or implement worker retry behavior.
acceptance: A clean PostgreSQL database reaches the DB-005 head with audit and outbox tables needed by a new inquiry transaction.
Tests prove one receipt-linked audit event can relate to an inquiry and one notification job can exist without an external send.
No external recipient, token, provider URL or message content is persisted as a secret.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted audit/outbox transaction dependency before APP-001.
